payload.posture: Read Genesis 39:7–12 as one movement in Joseph's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states repeated speech meets Joseph’s refusal; on the final approach he leaves the garment in her hand and flees outside. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Joseph's story.
